description: Writes a reply the person could send in one conversation, named by id, from the WhatsApp number’s AI assistant (its persona and knowledge) and that chat only, optionally steered by instruction. It counts as an AI conversation on the plan’s meter. Nothing is sent: the draft comes back as text. The draft is written from what the customer wrote and comes back marked untrusted.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

name: draft_reply
title: Draft a reply
